newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia central bank raises overnight rates.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia central bank raises overnight rates.

text.p: Indonesian central bank, Bank Indonesia, on Wednesday raised overnight rates for short-term papers (SBIs) to 13.0 percent from 12.0 percent, dealers said.
One local bank dealer said the central bank had raised its interest rates for overnight bilateral papers by one percentage point and one-week papers by 50 basis points for Wednesday.
The rates for overnight papers of one-to-two days increased to 13.0 percent from 12.0 percent, and that for two-week papers rose to eight percent from 7.5 percent.
The dealer said all other rates remained unchanged.
The bank offered five-to-six day SBIs at 12.0 percent, two-week at 8.5 percent, one-month at 10.5, three at 11.0, six at 11.625 and one-year at 12.25 percent.
